name: Full body 20
description: A 20 minute head-to-toe routine covering spine, hips, hamstrings, adductors, ankles and shoulders. A solid stand-alone mobility session.

items.cue: Move with your breath: inhale to arch, exhale to round.
Pedal your heels and push the floor away.
Sink the hips, then rotate and follow your hand.
Squeeze the back glute and lift the chest slowly.
Flex the front foot, hinge with a flat back.
Sit tall and hinge over the front shin.
Keep the hips square, rest on the forearms if you can.
Soles together, sit tall and let the knees drop.
Kneecaps up, fold from the hips.
No weight or very light. Roll down slowly, roll up slowly.
Heels down, elbows nudge the knees out.
Rotate from the mid back, hips stay still.
Hips over knees, let the chest sink.
Both shoulders stay heavy on the floor.
Sink back and slow your breathing.
